data: Mlada žena pokušava shvatiti kako je nestao čovjek iz njene prošlosti, koji nikada nije pronađen. Rat u Hrvatskoj zapanjio je Europu i svijet. Ovo je priča o potrazi za istinom na mjestu gdje je istina skrivena i od koje se bježi. (The "Sixth Bus" is a film about a young American trying to find a man from her past never to be found, during a biggest conflict on European soil since WWII-battle of Vukovar. It is about a search for identity; simmering beneath this need is a quest for faith,connection and redemption. The "Sixth Bus" is a search for truth in a place where truth is selective, elusive and even feared.Ultimately the "Sixth Bus" is a film about awakening and freedom.)

Mlada žena pokušava shvatiti kako je nestao čovjek iz njene prošlosti, koji nikada nije pronađen. Rat u Hrvatskoj zapanjio je Europu i svijet. Ovo je priča o potrazi za istinom na mjestu gdje je istina skrivena i od koje se bježi.

The "Sixth Bus" is a film about a young American trying to find a man from her past never to be found, during a biggest conflict on European soil since WWII-battle of Vukovar. It is about a search for identity; simmering beneath this need is a quest for faith,connection and redemption. The "Sixth Bus" is a search for truth in a place where truth is selective, elusive and even feared.Ultimately the "Sixth Bus" is a film about awakening and freedom.
